    # The 'Invite members' dialog is already open from previous actions
    # Step 1: Locate the textbox inside the dialog for entering member names

    if await invite_textbox.count() > 0:
        collaborators = ["Jakub K", "Alex Dills", "Alex Hutnik", "Benoît Blanchon"]
        for collaborator in collaborators:
            await invite_textbox.fill(collaborator)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)  # Wait for suggestions or UI update
            
            # Step 2: Select a role from the combobox using .select_option() as per tree
            role_combobox = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Invite members").get_by_role("combobox", name="Select a role")
            if await role_combobox.count() > 0:
                await role_combobox.select_option("Developer")  # Default role as per tree
            
            # Step 3: Look for an invite button in the dialog and ensure it's enabled
            invite_button = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Invite members").get_by_role("button", name="Invite")
            if await invite_button.count() == 0:
                invite_button = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Invite members").get_by_role("button", name="Add")
            
            if await invite_button.count() > 0:
                # Check if the button is enabled before clicking
                is_disabled = await invite_button.get_attribute("disabled")
                if is_disabled is None:
                    await invite_button.click()
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for the action to complete
                else:
                    # If disabled, try pressing Enter as fallback
                    await invite_textbox.press("Enter")
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            else:
                # Fallback: press Enter after filling the textbox
                await invite_textbox.press("Enter")
                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            
            # Clear the textbox for the next collaborator
            await invite_textbox.fill("")
            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    else:
        print("Could not find textbox in the 'Invite members' dialog.")
    
    # After adding all collaborators, close the dialog if it's still open
    close_button = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Invite members").get_by_role("button", name="Close")
    if await close_button.count() > 0:
        await close_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
